project_name: BranchIQ 2.0 — District, Town, City, PIN-code and Location-Level Banking Branch Expansion Intelligence Platform
archetype: ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST + ARCHETYPE 5: LUXURY CONSULTING (McKinsey/BCG Strategy Executive Decision System)

theme_strategy.character: High-density institutional consulting intelligence platform. Crisp borders, dense analytical tables, high-contrast KPI cards, interactive Leaflet geospatial drill-down maps, and transparent analytical scoring models.

entry_surfaces./: Executive intelligence platform with deep navy sidebar left, top bank/data selector header, and multi-tier analytics canvas featuring progressive drill-down (Bank → State → District → Town/City → PIN Code → Location), interactive Leaflet branch geospatial map, ranked tables, and scoring side-panels.

layout_and_grids.sidebar: w-64 min-w-64 bg-[#071426] border-r border-[#16273F] flex flex-col z-30 transition-all duration-200
layout_and_grids.header: h-16 border-b border-[#DFE7F0] bg-white px-6 flex items-center justify-between z-20 shrink-0

features: Bank selector dropdown (grouped Public Sector Banks: SBI, PNB, BOB, Canara; Private Sector Banks: HDFC, ICICI, Axis, Kotak)
Live data status indicator badge ('● RBI & Census Datasets Connected')
'Generate Executive Report' primary CTA button triggering comprehensive printable dossier modal
Quick search bar for PIN codes, Towns, Districts (e.g., '560001', 'Indiranagar', 'Pune')

location_intelligence_view.description: The flagship BranchIQ 2.0 progressive drill-down module.
drill_down_steps: 1. Select Bank (e.g. ICICI Bank, State Bank of India, HDFC Bank)
2. Select State (e.g. Maharashtra, Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Uttar Pradesh, Gujarat)
3. Select District (e.g. Pune, Bengaluru Urban, Mumbai Suburban, Ahmedabad)
4. Select Town/City/Taluk (e.g. Indiranagar, Hinjewadi, Whitefield, Kothrud)
6. Select/Inspect Candidate Branch Location (e.g. Hinjewadi Phase 1 Tech Park, Indiranagar 100ft Rd Metro)
widgets: Progressive drilldown breadcrumb ribbon with instant jump tokens
Multi-layer Interactive Geospatial Map (Leaflet) with Bank Branches (Blue), Competitor Branches (Slate), Candidate Expansion Sites (Gold/Green with pulsating ring)
Radius catchment buffer toggles (1km, 3km, 5km) with live population, deposit pool, and commercial density calculation
Cannibalization & Overlap risk indicator (distance to closest sister branch with risk score 0-100%)
Transparent 6-Pillar Opportunity Score breakdown card (Credit-Deposit Ratio, Unbanked Population Density, Commercial Activity, Competitor Whitespace, MSME Hub Index, Infrastructure Growth)
'Why this location?' strategic rationale bullet points + risk flags
Data Confidence & Provenance metadata drawer (Source: RBI DBIE, Census 2011/2024 Projections, MoSPI MSME Registry, GSTN Economic Indicators)
Competitive proximity list (Nearest HDFC, Axis, SBI, Kotak branches with distance in km)

features: Custom SVG pin markers with bank icons and opportunity badges
Interactive popups with Quick Score, Estimated Deposit Pool (₹ Cr), Cannibalization Risk, and 'Inspect Deep Dive' action
Catchment buffer circles with translucent fills
Heatmap overlay toggle for Economic Activity Density
Filter controls directly above map: Minimal Opportunity Score (0-100), Max Cannibalization %, Competitor Distance threshold

kpi_cards.style: bg-white border border-[#DFE7F0] rounded-[14px] p-5 shadow-sm relative overflow-hidden transition-all duration-200 hover:shadow-md hover:border-[#CBD5E1]
kpi_cards.accent_bar: h-1 w-full absolute top-0 left-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1687F8] to-[#27C3E8]

capabilities: Pre-seeded strategic questions ('Why should ICICI open in Hinjewadi Phase 1 vs Wakad?', 'Calculate cannibalization risk for SBI in Indiranagar', 'Rank top 5 unbanked PIN codes in Pune district')
Structured consulting replies with table references, score citations, and downloadable execution checklist

features: Executive Summary for C-Suite (MD/CEO & Head of Retail Banking)
Prioritized Branch Opening Roadmap (Quarter-by-Quarter CapEx & ROI projection)
Export as PDF / Print formatted dossier

accessibility.wcag_compliance: WCAG AA (minimum 4.5:1 text contrast for all labels and table data)
accessibility.data_testid_convention: kebab-case role-based test IDs for every interactive filter, select, button, tab, and map marker (e.g. data-testid='bank-selector-dropdown', data-testid='drilldown-district-select', data-testid='candidate-location-card-560038', data-testid='generate-report-btn')

image_urls.description: ICICI Bank illuminated branch exterior for Indian banking context preview
Modern urban retail banking branch entrance

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Preserve the existing modern BranchIQ aesthetic faithfully (Light #F4F7FB canvas, Deep Navy #071426 executive sidebar, #1687F8 professional blue, #27C3E8 cyan accent, #DFE7F0 borders, and 14px rounded cards).

2. Implement the full progressive drill-down workflow: Bank (Public & Private) -> State -> District -> Town/City/Taluk -> PIN Code -> Candidate Branch Location with seamless reactivity across tables, maps, and score cards.
3. Install 'leaflet' and '@types/leaflet' in frontend for rich interactive OpenStreetMap tiles with custom SVG bank pins, competitor dots, and candidate opportunity rings.

4. Deliver comprehensive data depth covering major Indian banking hubs and emerging tier-2/3 growth corridors (Maharashtra: Pune, Mumbai Suburban, Thane, Nagpur, Nashik; Karnataka: Bengaluru Urban, Mysuru, Belagavi; Tamil Nadu: Chennai, Coimbatore; Gujarat: Ahmedabad, Surat; Uttar Pradesh: Gautam Buddha Nagar/Noida, Lucknow; Telangana: Hyderabad).

5. Ensure every candidate location card shows: 6-pillar score breakdown (0-100), CD Ratio, Estimated 3-Year Deposit Pool (₹ Cr), Unbanked Population Catchment, Cannibalization Risk score, and Clear Rationale bullets.
6. Include the Strategic AI Consultant with interactive pre-calculated expansion scenarios and deep analytical explanations.
7. Implement the Executive Report Generation modal with export/print layout for C-level bank executives.
8. Maintain strict data-testid attributes on all interactive controls for testability.
